item.title: Russia expected to intensify hybrid war on Europe
item.description:
Denmark’s intelligence service warned Thursday that Russia would escalate its hybrid warfare campaign against the West in coming months, citing a “low but growing risk” of direct attack by Moscow. Denmark’s intel chief said the aim of such an attack is “not to take over the country, but to ⁠divide NATO ” at a time of heightened friction between Europe and the US; Washington has downplayed the possibility of Russian attacks. Rising far-right parties in Europe have worried Ukraine supporters that the bloc’s support could be undermined from within: A Kremlin envoy and Germany’s AfD leadership have discussed restarting gas supplies , and French far-right leader Marine Le Pen said Thursday that Paris could “ no longer provide financial assistance ” to Kyiv. — Brendan Ruberry

item.title: Al Gore on the Global Climate Crisis: “We’re Going to Win This”
item.description:
This story was originally published by the Guardian and is reproduced here as part of the Climate Desk collaboration. Two decades after the release of his groundbreaking documentary An Inconvenient Truth , Al Gore has admitted he was surprised by the ferocious, ongoing backlash from the fossil fuel industry and its political allies. But the former US vice-president insists he still has optimism the world will confront the climate crisis.
